content: विचर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> To wander about, roam over (<ab>oft.</ab> with <ab>acc.</ab>); इष्टान् देशान् विचर जलद <ls>Me. 117</ls>; विचचार दावम् <ls>R. 2. 8</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 31</ls>. .²2 To do, perform, practise. .²3 To act, deal, behave. .²4 To deviate from the right path, go about wantonly; यन्मे माता प्रलुलुभे विचरन्त्यपतिव्रता <ls>Ms. 9. 20</ls>. .²5 To pass through, pervade. .²6 To attack, march against. .²7 To associate or have intercourse with. .²8 To go badly, fail. .²9 To commit a mistake; हविषि व्यचरत्तेन वषट्कारं गृणन् द्विजः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 1. 15</ls>. .²10 To graze or feed upon. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To think, reflect or meditate upon; विचारमाणस्य विशुद्धभावना <ls>A. Rām. 7. 5. 45</ls>. .²2 To discuss, call in question, debate; आज्ञा गुरूणां ह्यविचारणीया <ls>R. 14. 46</ls>. .²3 To calculate, estimate, take into account, consider; परेषामात्मनश्चैव यो विचार्य बलाबलम् <ls>Pt. 3</ls>; सुविचार्य यत्कृतम् <ls>H. 1. 20</ls>. .²4 To hesitate, doubt. .²5 To examine, investigate. .²6 To seduce.
